articles.title: A Deep Dive into the Inline Background Overlap Problem
articles.description: If you want to get a semi-transparent background behind some inline text with nice padding you’ll likely face an overlap problem. Ana goes deep into exploring the solution along with some of the more complex variations of the issue that we could face.
articles.author: Ana Tudor

articles.title: Introducing command and commandfor
articles.description: Chrome 135 (and preview versions of Firefox and Safari) add support for two new HTML attributes, command and commandfor. They’re for adding declarative actions to HTML buttons without directly requiring JavaScript.
articles.author: Keith Cirkel

articles.title: 🕵️‍♂️ Buying Browser Extensions for Fun and Profit
articles.description: An interesting look into the shadowy world of how browser extensions, with hundreds of thousands of users, can be easily bought — potentially by malicious proprietors.
articles.author: John Tucker

articles.title: Styling Counters in CSS
articles.description: A guide to styling counters, going from the most basic ways to style lists directly in HTML to advanced customization techniques that are even capable of making things that aren’t lists look like lists.
articles.author: Juan Diego Rodríguez

articles.title: Self Gap
articles.description: Some thinking on how best to control a custom gap between some flex or grid elements. As ever, Ahmad has code examples and solid demos to help explain the approaches considered.
articles.author: Ahmad Shadeed

articles.title: Breadcrumbs are 'Dead' in Web Design
articles.description: Once a clear staple in web design, the author argues that they’ve now become somewhat obsolete in “today’s non-linear, context-driven web, where dynamic and personalized navigation systems take precedence”.
articles.author: Noah Davis

articles.title: Design Systems Need a Color Space
articles.description: “Software developers and designers have been able to ignore colour spaces for a long time, but it’s about to become required knowledge.”
articles.author: Marc Edwards

articles.title: Chilled Out Text Underlines
articles.description: Shares a nice treatment for styling underlines. Worth keeping in mind accessibility considerations though.
articles.author: Chris Coyier

articles.title: Styling an HTML Dialog Modal to Take the Full Height of the Viewport
articles.description: Simon encountered an issue with an unwanted gap appearing when using the dialog element. Here’s how it was solved.
articles.author: Simon Willison

articles.title: Web Components vs. Framework Components: What’s the Difference?
articles.description: A comprehensive comparison between Web Components and framework components, discussing their definitions, strengths, weaknesses, and various performance considerations.
articles.author: Gabriel Shoyombo

articles.title: Use Cases for the Document Picture-in-Picture API
articles.description: A way to open a floating, always-on-top window (‘picture-in-picture’) that can display arbitrary HTML content. Chrome only, though.
articles.author: Jad Joubran

articles.title: But How to Get to That European Cloud?
articles.description: A thoughtful take on a pressing need for an increase in geographically diverse web infrastructure. Touches on broader political considerations that, naturally, not everyone may see the same way — but, ‘don’t put all your eggs in one basket’ is generally good advice.
articles.author: Bert Hubert

articles.title: Tailwind Gradient Generator: Create CSS Gradients for Tailwind Projects
articles.description: Select to preview any of the existing gradients in the gallery and customize the ‘direction’ of the gradient. You can also preview the gradient on text (as seen above) or just as a regular background.
articles.author: oxbow ui

articles.title: Loadership: An Interactive Tool to Build and Customize Pure CSS Loading Animations
articles.description: Click any of the dozen or so prebuilt loaders (which are unique!) and you can customize them to your liking (color, speed, size, etc).
articles.author: Loadership

articles.title: Enhance: Enhance and Upscale Your Images Using AI
articles.description: Yet another single-purpose image editing tool from Addy Osmani, this one is a simple AI-powered image upscaler/enhancer that you can try out online here.
articles.author: Addy Osmani

articles.title: svg2pdf.js: SVG to PDF Conversion in the Browser
articles.description: There’s an online playground to give you a feel for what it can do.
articles.author: yWorks GmbH

articles.title: shiki-stream: Generate "Streaming" Syntax Highlighted Code
articles.description: Based on the popular Shiki syntax highlighter, this will reveal the selected code line by line (i.e. in a “stream”), which you can play with here.
articles.author: Anthony Fu

articles.title: Frontend Practice: A Practice Ground for Improving Frontend Skills
articles.description: A collection of real sites each with a spec sheet that you can use to recreate the project to improve your skills.
articles.author: Kyle Shook
